scope: Evaluate SSG transient code workspace and evidence critic for AM research; no production graph/embedding integration and no security findings.
interpretation: Source-bound properties below are code/prompt observations, not proof of model judgment quality. Actual fixture observations are retained separately and never redefine frozen expected-facts.json.

source_bound_properties.property: Repository writes use workspace connect, which compares the configured workspace/shared address strings. Managed workspace up is loopback-published, tmpfs for data/logs, WAL/snapshots disabled and --rm. No address canonicalization or principal/ACL separation is established here. up itself has no CPU/memory cap; this recipe starts only its exact graph with explicit caps.

Load first deletes all nodes from the selected workspace, rebuilds authored expertise plus package-scoped advisories, then stores repository root/commit/content, files with parse/hash metadata, callables, confidence-labelled calls, entries/trust and symbol-match rules. This is transient source-derived graph data, not model-asserted data. Selecting the wrong real database is destructive; endpoint-string inequality is not an authorization boundary.

Entry association can choose the nearest name or a handler declared within eight lines; it is not full framework dispatch semantics. Entries under test/example/fixture/benchmark paths become test trust. Library API inference and registrations remain heuristic.

Path joins combine in-range dependency facets and synthetic matched callees with first-party BFS routes, confidence and entry trust. One best route per caller favors exposure, then hop count, then weakest edge. Sources/guards on a route or one helper beside it are reported as calls, not dominance, alias, value-flow or guard-effectiveness proofs. Unreached is coverage, not safety; dynamic dispatch/callback/reflection omissions are explicit.

Profile ranks reached > called > lexical > present; classes inherit strongest facet rank and methods inherit classes. This is typed navigation, not similarity or vulnerability severity. Its reachability query ignores edge confidence although path routes filter confidence; do not assume profile reached and a selected confidence-specific path are identical.

Fingerprint compute performs canonical cgg and binds content hashes/build/binary. latest merely reads the cache pointer and fingerprint. Workspace require_loaded compares the stored Repo content with that cached fingerprint, not a fresh hash of current files. It can therefore answer stale routes after an unrefingerprinted working-tree edit; actual control records this boundary.

Stopping the graph disposes neither the local canonical cgg cache/fingerprint nor assessments/traces/critic files. These carry paths, source excerpts, claims and tool output. Cache privacy mode is 0700, not automatic erasure. This recipe removes only its own marked scratch repo/cache after preserving intentionally public synthetic raw evidence.

Trace constructs numbered facts before a model sees the route: nonblank source lines (short functions whole; long functions head plus +/-12-line windows), one-hop side-helper guard code, matching expertise keys and capped 1800-character sink/class bodies. Fact IDs map back to exact path/line or unit, then generate references. Source read failure yields an empty excerpt. Numbering or quotation does not prove excerpt completeness, program behavior or expertise correctness.

Trace model calls choose quoted facts, reason through source/flow/guard/conditions/breaking input, then determine reachable/blocked/unresolved. A conclusion-word check retries once and can cap reachable to unresolved. References are computed only from known IDs, but substantive dataflow remains model reasoning; a trace is explicitly a reviewer lead, not a finding. No model call is made by this qualification.

Assessment resolves typed code, fact, path, entry, advisory, tool and gaps references. Code stores a full-file blake3 and numbered excerpt (max60 lines), with stale rejection when its path matches the cached graph-file key. Fact stores status/unit digest/build, not a proof of truth. Path is shortest cached-cgg reachability preferring stronger edges. Storage checks reference existence and shape, not truth of statement/reasoning or posture appropriateness; unsupported prose can still be stored.

Both fixture-relevant facets are proposed expertise. eval with a constant string is not injected code, while ast.literal_eval is a code-execution safe lookalike but may exhaust resources. Generic receiver names can overmatch eval/exec; compile prefix matching also needs a human callee check. A stored graph fact retains these epistemic limits.

The independent critic sees only the assessment JSON, not repository/graph/tools. Its rubric demands supported statements, credible path confidence, quoted guards for non-findings, depth/scope limits, valid dependency claims and acknowledgment of proposed expertise. Defender must quote exact evidence or concede; arbiter judges the record, not tone. These are desirable prompt disciplines, not experimentally established compliance.

Critic dispatch can invoke spend-bearing Claude/OMP/Codex backends, including a cascade's external stage2. Operator-local critic.toml can select backend/model/endpoint; CLI flags win. Claude is invoked no-tools/no-settings/no-MCP/no-session-persistence, checks schema and exact claim IDs/order, and binds output to assessment blake3. That protects identity/shape, not verdict correctness. This recipe never invokes critique or trace and names an absent private critic config.

Local critic constrains structured output, probes grammar support, verifies quoted evidence and caps mechanically unsupported verdicts. Non-loopback endpoints require explicit remote permission plus transport constraints. Slotted prefill fences repository text as untrusted quoted data and flags instruction-like content. None constitutes an empirical prompt-injection-resistance or solver-quality guarantee here.

adopt_principles_not_runtime: Store provenance with each derived typed fact: source identity, checkout/content generation, parser/tool version, path/range/hash, confidence/match rule, review status and supported scope. Keep authored/project facts distinct from LLM claims and critic verdicts.

Offer explainable typed navigation and separately report reached/called/lexical/present evidence. Preserve explicit uncovered/unknown and confidence boundaries; do not convert graph reachability, cooccurrence, similarity or absence into semantic truth.

Resolve evidence references from immutable generation-bound source snapshots, not model-retyped excerpts. Bind claims and critic output to exact input digests, preserve typed evidence and independently evaluate false-positive/negative controls.

Keep transient code/repository graph, caches, assessments and completion-provider disclosure physically separate from authorized persistent project/shared memory. Source-derived code must never silently become shared lessons. Admission and export permission remain separate.

Require current source-generation checks before answering; quote/render complete-enough evidence with explicit missing/truncated material. A mutable checkout plus cached fingerprint is not a sufficient current-content guarantee.

Make teardown inventory all owned data planes, not just the graph. Record exact container identity/label/port and scratch ownership; distinguish engine-visible disposal from forensic erasure or provider retention.
do_not_adopt: No whole SSG runtime/product adoption or security-domain schema copied into AM by this study.
No shared/workspace address string comparison as the sole privacy boundary, no global delete on a merely caller-selected database, no runtime alias-based isolation claim.
No proposed expertise promoted to reviewed fact, and no LLM determination, critic vote, grammar-valid JSON or fluent prose promoted to stored ground truth.
No nearest-handler/hop-window route or one-helper guard enumeration sold as complete semantic navigation or safety analysis.
No automatic model spend or remote export through inherited critic defaults; no embedding model used as a reasoning critic.
No stopped tmpfs container described as disposing local source caches, assessments, exports, backups, RAM, VM swap or provider copies.
am_recommendations.recommendation: Adopt evidence/provenance/typed-navigation disciplines in AM's independently approved graph design, not SSG's entire runtime or security critic. Treat critic as optional, separately authorized and empirically qualified claim review; keep uncertain claims and unsupported semantics explicit.

unavailable_prerequisites: No actual appropriate completion endpoint/model/profile is supplied or authorized. Critic verdict quality, accuracy, consistency, prompt-injection robustness and cost are unmeasured, not passed.

One owned graph is allowed. It is used first for real expertise build/fingerprint read queries and then as the real repository workspace; no live second shared graph is created or probed. Separation observations cannot prove credential-level or address-alias isolation.

This small Python/Flask static fixture does not qualify all cgg languages, dynamic dispatch, callbacks, branch-sensitive dataflow, guard semantics, version constraints, process-launch routes, large/private repositories or AM coding benefit.
Actual timings are under ordinary shared host load with concurrent parent native/recovery work and are descriptive only.

reproduction.rerun: Keep old freeze/outputs. With unchanged frozen inputs, choose a new direct-child --out; do not overwrite prior failures. Requires exact local SSG/cgg/image, podman and neo4j Python dependency. No build, test suite, formatter or fixture execution is involved; the SSG graph build is the research workload itself.
